name: fix-table-merge-picker
title: Fix table merge picker opening
description: Expose a visible searchable same-floor table picker and widen the table detail modal without changing merge business rules.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The previous implementation still depended on per-element DOM listeners and replaying a React button click. The corrective fix keeps one stable delegated handler, inserts an explicit picker button, loads the same-floor list directly, and leaves the GraphQL contract and merge validation unchanged.
